This order hasnt shipped yet. Is there any way i can switch my order to the
new harlo lotto from the harlo H15? Its the same exact price. Just curious
if its possible still.

Hi there,

Yes, it's still possible. Your order hasn't shipped, so I can switch the H15 to another product myself, on the same order number.

I just can't find a "Harlo Lotto" in our store right now. The Harlo products we sell are the H15 Dual ($799), the B30 ($899), the B30 + H15 Duo Pack ($1,599) and the B1 ($99). None of them is called the Lotto, and none is new at the H15's price. Could you send me a link to the page where you saw it, or tell me which one you meant?

Please also send your order number and one detail from the order: the name it ships to, the postcode ····email you used. Once I have those, I'll check the price difference against what you actually paid for the H15. I'll confirm it with you before I change anything.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
